verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase counts "cover the sessions that reached the new page" while "a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout", so the 6/4/7/5 percent gains are computed on the surviving three-quarters that got as far as the new checkout page, not on all sessions. That is a narrower population than the claim about purchases overall, and a page that lifts the rate among reachers can leave total purchases flat.

The figures "cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service" but "a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed", so the 12/9/14/8 percent reductions are drawn from a hand-picked three-quarters of runs and compared against an earlier quarter that was not similarly filtered. The measured population is narrower than the stack output the claim is about.

The abduction averages "cover the patients who kept up the home exercises" while "a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse", so the 14/11/16/9 degree gains come only from the adherent three-quarters. Adherers are systematically the patients with less pain and better function, so the selected subset, not the protocol, can produce the gain.

The germination rates "cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat" while "about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed" and are excluded, so the 9/6/11/7 point gains rest on seed selected for having taken a full coat. Seed that takes a full coat is plausibly the plumper, sounder seed, so the excluded fifth makes the measured population narrower than the lot the claim is about.
